desc: Ideate approach: enumerate target subsets (≤15), LCM per subset, min cost to reach a multiple of LCM, subset DP for set cover
Implement cost[mask]: for L = lcm(subset), if L > max(nums) cost = L - max(nums); else iterate multiples m ≤ max(nums), use bisect on sorted nums for largest element ≤ m, track min(m - value)
Implement subset DP: dp[mask] = min over non-empty submask s of dp[mask ^ s] + cost[s], dp[0] = 0
Write full Solution class with imports
Verify solution against examples 1-3 and edge cases (duplicate targets, cost-0 cases, nums length 1, large LCM); brute-force cross-check on small random inputs
